queries.sql: SELECT psi.*, pm.generic_name, pm.brand_name, pm.strength, pm.hsn_code, pm.gst_rate, pb.batch_number, pb.expiry_date, um.name AS unit_name FROM pharmacy_sale_items psi JOIN pharmacy_medicines pm ON pm.id = psi.medicine_id JOIN pharmacy_batches pb ON pb.id = psi.batch_id LEFT JOIN pharmacy_units_of_measure um ON um.id = pm.unit_of_measure_id WHERE psi.billing_id = '14'
